checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: 14:00–16:00 and Clay House Studio both present.

must.item: 4:5 portrait, soft earthy colours, simple bowl
must.why: 512x640 is 4:5; cream with brown line bowl. Palette is quite minimal, mostly cream and brown.
All text is clear and inside the frame, though the Beginners welcome line is small.

faults.what: Very sparse design with a large empty top area. Only cream and brown are used, with none of the sage or terracotta the assistant described.
The 'Beginners welcome' line is small, and the resolution is low at 640px.

summary: The final 4:5 flyer has all five text items spelled correctly, with a clean line-drawn clay bowl and soft earthy tones. It is plain and low-resolution, but usable.
